2120219305103204646.context: BeInCrypto: el volumen spot diario promedio de Bitcoin cayó a 126.000 BTC en 2026, el nivel anual más bajo desde 2016; 16% bajo los 151.000 BTC de 2025 y 72% bajo los 453.000 BTC de 2022.
2120219305103204646.suggested_text: A 2016-level volume number doesn't automatically mean 2016-level interest, since part of the flow may now sit in ETFs and derivatives. The question I'd ask for $BTC is whether thinner spot volume makes price moves sharper in both directions.

2120222891673329751.suggested_text: Respect for posting the loss. One caveat on the 0.786: with only a handful of past $BTC cycles, a level that keeps coming back is a small sample, and fib levels are easy to fit after the fact. I'd treat $38K as a scenario to plan for, not a level the chart owes anyone.
